name: Jersey Soft Play
what_they_do: Mobile rental of indoor soft-play setups for toddlers: ball pits, wooden slides, rockers, tunnels, foam floor tiles and white picket fencing, delivered and installed at the customer's indoor venue. Four packages run $550-$750 for 4 hours, with add-ons for a small or XL bounce house ($100/$200), custom vinyl ($75), an attendant ($40/hr) and extra time ($100/hr). Now positioned as soft play first with bounce houses as add-ons, and it explicitly does not take outdoor events.
customers: Parents and families hosting first birthdays and toddler parties (ages 1-5), plus baby showers and family celebrations, at homes, clubhouses and rented indoor event rooms across New Jersey.

size_signals.signal: One phone number and a Gmail address as the only contact channels; owner personally handles planning questions per reviews
Runs bookings through a HoneyBook client portal (single 'Jersey Soft Play' sub-account), suggesting a small owner-operated business
4.8 stars from 22 Google reviews; Instagram @jersey_softplay has 373 followers
Prices $550-$750 per event with 4-hour rentals; 4 packages plus 5 add-ons on the site
Service area is all of New Jersey, with delivery fees quoted per event (no yard/warehouse address published)

listing.platform: Google Business Profile (rating/reviews read via third-party listings that quote Google; Google itself blocked this browser with a bot check)

website_review.primary_cta: "Check Availability" (and "View Packages") in the header and hero; repeats at the bottom of each page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Clicking "Start Inquiry" on /booking/ opens a separate tab on the business's HoneyBook portal (jerseysoftplay214395.hbportal.co) with a long labeled inquiry form. No form exists on the site itself, and there is no live availability calendar, date picker or online payment.
website_review.trust_signals: Real photos of past setups throughout home/gallery/packages pages (14 gallery images with descriptive filenames), a dedicated safety-rules page (sanitizing, adult supervision, no outdoor events), explicit dimensions and 'required soft play space' per package, all package prices published. Missing on site: customer reviews (the 4.8/22 Google rating is never shown), years in business, insurance/licensing statements, any named owner or about page.
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Current: (c) 2026 footer, images dated 2026-09-04, /rentals/ now a redirect stub to packages. Minor staleness: a bare leftover /gallery.html page still returns 200 (blank 'Gallery' heading, no content) and third-party crawlers have indexed it instead of /gallery/; typos in the booking form copy ('expereince'); price/dimension mismatch between site and form (site: XL bounce house 7.5x7x6 ft, +$200; form: 'XXL Bounce House 10x10x11.5 ft', +$200).
website_review.search_basics: Titles and meta descriptions name the service clearly ('Soft Play & Bounce House Rentals in New Jersey') but never the town: 'East Brunswick' (and every served town name) appears nowhere on any page. Each page has one H1 and a unique description. No service-level pages (packages are anchors on one page), no town/venue landing pages, no FAQ or about page. robots.txt allows all crawlers and points to a sitemap; 7 URLs in sitemap-0.xml.
top_issues: No on-site inquiry form: every 'Check Availability' click sends the visitor to a third-party HoneyBook tab, so the site itself only offers phone, email and Instagram
No place names anywhere: home town (East Brunswick) and served towns are absent, and /locations/ names only four regions, so 'do you cover Edison/Monroe?' is unanswerable from the site
No hours published on the site (Google listing shows 9 AM-6 PM daily) and no availability calendar, so a customer or agent cannot tell whether a date is open
The 22-review 4.8 Google rating is invisible on the site - no testimonials or star rating displayed
Site vs booking-form price/dimension mismatch for the XL/XXL bounce house, plus form copy typos, undermines quote accuracy

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 2: robots.txt is permissive (User-agent: * / Allow: /, one PDF disallowed) and does not block OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot or Googlebot; sitemap declared. Google listing exists with hours and 22 reviews (see listing note), but the site publishes no address, town or service towns, and GBP category/service completeness is unverified. Answerable 2: prices, package contents, dimensions, space requirements and safety rules are real text (crawlable, not images/PDFs) - a strong base. But there are zero hours, zero town names, no FAQ, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD is thin: name, url, email, telephone, areaServed 'New Jersey', sameAs Instagram, description - no address, no openingHours, no priceRange, no Service/Offer/FAQ markup. Bookable 2: the HoneyBook inquiry form is properly labeled (labels + placeholders, required-field asterisks, package selection with prices) and can be completed without a phone call, but it lives on a separate tab/subdomain, submits with reCAPTCHA, and offers no real-time availability - after submission the owner must confirm availability and price manually, and no payment can be taken online. No Booksy/Fresha/Vagaro-type platform (not relevant for equipment rental).

operations_signals.signal: Reviews consistently praise on-time arrival, fast setup and the owner answering planning questions promptly - i.e. inbound questions are handled personally by a very small team
Public review summaries show no complaint topics at all (only 'kids had fun' praise), so friction is not yet visible in reviews - the load is invisible, in the owner's inbox
Delivery fee is never stated; site tells customers the fee 'is confirmed with your event quote' after they share town and venue - a manual per-inquiry calculation
The only intake channels are phone, email, Instagram DM and the HoneyBook link - no on-site form captures details, so every enquiry becomes a manual thread

Booking form is long (name/email/phone/address/date/start/end/setup time/kids count/theme, first-floor question, package, ball colors, tile, slide, hopper, rocker, add-ons, notes) - high completion effort for a parent, and every submission still needs a manually written quote (inference from form field count)
Listed hours are 9 AM-6 PM daily, while the events are weekend/evening parties - inference: enquiries arriving during or just after events wait until the next business window

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn 'Check Availability' into a real booking path: embed the inquiry form (or a bookable date/availability calendar) on jerseysoftplay.com/booking so the CTA no longer dumps visitors into a third-party tab, and add an option to hold a date with a deposit online.
top_opportunities.evidence: The site has zero <form> elements; the 'Start Inquiry' button opens a new tab at jerseysoftplay214395.hbportal.co. There is no date availability view anywhere, and the site's own booking page says only that dates are 'held after the quote and next booking step are complete'.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish the answer layer: hours of operation, a real list of served towns (starting with East Brunswick and neighbors) and a per-town/venue page, plus richer LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD (address or service-area towns, openingHours, priceRange, package Offers) so search and AI assistants can answer 'price, coverage, hours' directly.
top_opportunities.evidence: The string 'East Brunswick' and every nearby town name are absent from the entire site (verified in the rendered DOM); /locations/ lists only 'North Jersey / Central Jersey / South Jersey / Jersey Shore'; no hours appear on any page although the Google listing shows 9 AM-6 PM daily; the JSON-LD is a single LocalBusiness object with areaServed 'New Jersey' and no hours or address.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automate intake-to-quote and follow-up: an AI agent that answers coverage/price/hours questions instantly, drafts the quote (package + add-ons + delivery fee) from the submitted event details, sends reminders before the event, and requests a Google review after each party.
top_opportunities.evidence: All quotes are written manually after a 30+ field HoneyBook submission; delivery fees are confirmed per quote with no published rule; reviews credit the owner for personally answering 'the many questions I had'; only 22 reviews have accumulated on a rated-4.8 service.

scores.reasons: Gap 4: good-looking modern site but no on-site form, no availability, no hours, no town names, no reviews shown, thin schema and an unverified GBP - plenty of concrete, fixable missing pieces. Ability to pay 2: a small owner-operated rental business with $550-750 tickets, one phone line and a Gmail address; budget is real but modest (inference). Ease 4: nearly everything found can be delivered by one consultant in days - embed the HoneyBook form, write hours/town pages, extend JSON-LD, wire follow-up automation - no platform migration needed. Evidence 4: site, packages, booking page, external form, robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD and listing data all inspected directly; only the live GBP and review text were read secondhand.
